source_text.body:
Read social posts and ad libraries via a logged-in browser
Claude in Chrome drives a logged-in browser to open Reels, TikTok, Pinterest and the Facebook Ad Library and read captions, ad copy, comments, engagement and landing URLs.
·
Nov 2, 2026
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
What they did
The thread says people do this by letting Claude drive a real logged-in browser through Claude in Chrome or the desktop app’s browser, so it can open Reels, TikTok, Pinterest, and Facebook Ad Library pages and read what is visible there, including captions, ad copy, comments, engagement counts, and landing-page URLs. For video posts, commenters say Claude does not truly watch the clip; they either rely on screenshots plus transcript, or manually prepare frames and a Whisper transcript before handing both to Claude.
How it went
The reported result is that Pinterest and Facebook Ad Library work fine through the logged-in browser, while Reels and TikTok usually need an extra transcript or frame-extraction step. Another commenter says Apify can return the same kinds of fields in structured form for bulk analysis, but notes it is paid beyond a free tier.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that pasting a plain link often fails on sites that require login, so the workable setup is a browser extension reading the page you already have open and authenticated.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Using my logged-in browser, open [Reels, TikTok, Pinterest, or Facebook Ad Library] and search for [brand, keyword, or competitor]. For the top [20] results, record the caption or ad copy, visible engagement, notable comments, and the landing page URL. Put everything in a table and stop when you have [20] entries; do not like, follow, comment, or submit anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xkyyce/how_can_i_get_claude_to_watch_content_and_open
